text:
olivia_m: Quick sync  launching webinar push next Tue. Need X thread (3 staggered posts), LinkedIn carousel (4 cards), 20s highlight clip, and a PM template for inbound leads. Who takes what? :loudspeaker:

rui_k: I can own copy + benchmark lines. Will draft 2 stat variants for A/B test and the short X thread copy.

dee_design: Ill do carousel + clip thumbnails. Put comps in figma and tag me. Need final headline + one-line CTAs by Mon noon.

jamie_s: I'll handle scheduling and reply ops for 48hrs. Prefer we stagger X posts 12/12 mins to keep momentum, then LinkedIn ~8 mins after final X post. Sam-bot can queue if we give exact UTC times.

sam-bot: Proposal queued: ``Tue 16:00 UTC: X post 1 (teaser)``, ``Tue 16:12 UTC: X post 2 (stat + CTA)``, ``Tue 16:24 UTC: X post 3 (final call)``, ``Tue 16:32 UTC: LinkedIn carousel``. Confirm to lock.

olivia_m: Confirm. Rui  put CTA short.redwood.ai/qualify on post 2. Also add UTMs for tracking: utm_campaign=webinar_nov2026.

rui_k: Will do. Stat A: "p95 latency down 42%". Stat B: "unit cost per call down 29%". Ill put A in post 2 and B in card 2 of the carousel.

dee_design: Figma link dropped (https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz/launch-kit). I left export presets: 1200x1200 carousel, 1200x630 share image, 16:9 clip. Also added a dark-mode fallback.

jamie_s: PM template idea: "Thanks for registering! Can you share one-sentence about your LLM use case? Reply 'demo' to request a walkthrough." I'll pin and batch replies hourly.

sam-bot: Reminder set: review drafts 30m before first post. Drafts queued; please review copy assets by Mon EOD.

olivia_m: Micro budget ask  $400 boost on stat post to test reach. KPI CPL target <$55. Agree?

rui_k: +1. If CPL >$80 after 24h, we pause. Adding UTM param: "?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_nov2026".

dee_design: One ask: include 9:16 vertical cut for clip (stories). Ill export both.

jamie_s: Also will add a pinned FAQ reply with links: qualifier, recording, docs. Keeps comments tidy.

olivia_m: Final checklist: Rui stats + copy (Mon EOD)  Dee designs + exports (Mon EOD)  Jamie scheduling + replies (queued). Flag any blockers here.

sam-bot: All set. Will post updates on drafts and send a 30m pre-post reminder.
